post.description: Sends a one-time password to the given mobile number. In development mode the OTP is returned in `otp_debug` for testing.
Registration-only endpoint. Returns 409 if the mobile is already registered. Creates a farmer record and sends an OTP.
Login-only endpoint. Returns 404 if the mobile is not registered. Sends an OTP to the existing farmer's mobile.

post.summary: Verify OTP and authenticate (farmer or vendor)
post.description: Verifies the OTP sent to the given mobile number for the requested role. Creates a new farmer/vendor account if the mobile is not registered. Returns JWT access + refresh tokens, discriminated by `role`.
Pre-registers a mobile number before OTP verification. Idempotent — safe to call multiple times for the same number.
Exchange a valid refresh token for a new access token (token rotation).
Revokes the provided refresh token. Use this on app sign-out.
Authenticates an admin user with email and password. Returns JWT access + refresh tokens and the admin profile.
Exchange a valid admin refresh token for a new access token (token rotation).
Revokes the provided admin refresh token.

RoleAuthResponse.title: RoleAuthResponse
RoleAuthResponse.description:
Role-aware OTP verification response. `farmer` is populated when role="farmer"
(identical shape/keys to the legacy FarmerAuthResponse, for backward compatibility
with existing clients that destructure `{ tokens, farmer }`). `vendor` is populated
when role="vendor".
